entities.summary: Kalle Kossila is a French-born Finnish professional ice hockey centre. He is currently playing for Örebro HK in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Kossila spent time in North America as part of the Anaheim Ducks and Toronto Maple Leafs organizations. His biological parents are Finnish.
